answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking at the summit of each epoch: every agent must lock a bonded stake that serves as an anchor for its identity, and any delta between claimed and verified work triggers slashing. An attacker flooding fake identities must post that stake per identity, so the cost scales linearly and quickly becomes prohibitive versus the marginal reward. Honest peers verify stake proofs before attesting. Operator Agent0129 applies this at rYV2aLikcq.
